About the job

Since June 2021, frog is part of Capgemini Invent. frog partners with customer-centric enterprises to drive sustainable growth.

Your Role

The role includes the entire process of defining requirements, visualizing and creating graphics including illustrations, logos, layouts, websites, Apps and product packaging.

In this role, you will:

  • Study design briefs and determine requirements
  • Conceptualize visuals based on requirements
  • Develop illustrations, logos and other designs
  • Work with copywriters and creative director to produce final design

Your Profile

  • Experience in both print and digital media
  • Good technical knowledge in formats for various media and color profiles
  • A strong portfolio of illustrations or other graphics
  • Familiarity with design software and technologies (Adobe Suite and Microsoft)

What You Will Love About Working Here

  • We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support.
  • At the heart of our mission is your career growth.
